recap.text: A level ninety-five Lady Mantaur Dominator with curly red hair and freckled skin chews tobacco while driving for the Lady Dominators. She tells Carl she will see him in the factory and offers to take Porky to match her ownership of Corky. Prepotente's hobble missile sends her GTO through a trapped floor in the doll-packing room, shearing off a golden wheel. She is eliminated at the close of Heat Five, surrounded by cocaine-infused action figures.

beats.headline: The other womantaur dominator
beats.text: Subject is a Lady Mantaur Dominator, level ninety-five, driving alongside her partner for the Lady Dominators. She has freckled skin and curly red hair and she chews tobacco. She says considerably less than her partner does, which in that vehicle is a structural necessity rather than a personality.
beats.gist: A level ninety-five Lady Mantaur Dominator with freckled skin and curly red hair chews tobacco.

beats.headline: A matched set
beats.text: Rapture, beside the driver, supplied the terms. They had heard about the fleshmancer at the bar. They asked after the crusty old stripper. Corky belongs to them, and they would unzip him and let him spill before handing him over. She patted the door with her lower arm and offered to take Porky too, since they would love a matched set. Then: "See you in the factory." A factory that was not there a moment ago now stands at the end of a new road across the cul-de-sac.
beats.gist: Rapture and the driver offer to unzip Corky and take Porky to a new factory.

beats.headline: Through the floor
beats.text: The GTO, shield down and hit by Prepotente's hobble missile, went through a trapped floor in the doll-packing room and landed on its side ten metres below: front smashed, a golden wheel sheared off, the axle broken in half. That vehicle is done. Rapture and Genesis are alive, groaning, strung out, and quite possibly without containment, which in this heat means cooking. Cocaine-infused action figures are taking the car apart around them. Crawler Carl's party removed Corky and drove on.
beats.gist: The GTO falls through a trapped floor in the doll-packing room and lands on its side.

beats.headline: The factory keeps her
beats.text: NPC Rapture, womantaur, dominator and co-owner of a gimp she declined to transfer, is eliminated with her team at the close of Heat Five. Her last recorded position was the bottom of a hole in the doll-packing room, beside Genesis, strung out, containment gone, in a building hot enough to boil anyone uncontained, surrounded by action figures. She told Crawler Carl she would see him in the factory. She was right about that much.
beats.gist: Rapture, a womantaur and dominator, is eliminated with her team at the close of Heat Five.
